content:
The image shows young mango shoots with leaves that are:
- Brown at the tips and margins, curling/crumpling inward
- The shoots appear stripped/bare with minimal leaf tissue remaining
- Pieces of leaf tissue appear damaged or missing
- The overall appearance is of damaged, brown-edged young leaves on visible stems

This matches **Cutting_Weevil** precisely: "Brown, curled and crumpled young leaves with visibly stripped shoots and pieces of fallen leaves under the tree. Young leaves turn brown, curl and crumple; shoots are visibly stripped and can be seen from a distance."

The triangular remnants of young leaves with brown edges on bare green stems is classic cutting weevil damage — the weevil cuts through young leaf tissue leaving only the base/petiole attached.
